messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for SOLSTICE-VPC: elevated 5xx (504s) and KV-cache eviction spikes. Runbook: /runbooks/vpc-model-errors. Paging oncall.
oncall-erin: I'm on it — pinging SRE and runtime. @eng-sre-max any signs of infra/network versus model?
eng-sre-max: infra metrics: GPU mem climb + OOM retries on nodes serving tenant solstice. Not seeing network loss. KV eviction correlates with v3-quant replicas.
eng-runtime-ali: v3-quant rollout completed for solstice at 03:00 UTC. My guess: quant path regression causing K/V thrash under prod seq lengths. Recommend immediate tenant-level pin to stable v2 safe variant.
support-jasmin: solstice ops: customers report ~20% request failures on autocomplete, some payments UX timeouts. They want minimal disruption and no data migrations.
eng-platform-lucas: I can run tenant pin now. Command: ```/rpin tenant=solstice model=stable-v2 scope=tenant reason="emergency rollback - kvcache thrash"```
oncall-erin: do it. also apply a derate to reduce inflight for this tenant (target 0.7) so we don't thrash the cache while pins propagate. :thumbsup:
eng-sre-max: derate applied at ingress for tenant=solstice -> 0.7. Observed ~30% drop in inflight tokens, queue length down. Error rate moving down in the last 2m.
incident-bot: Event: tenant-pin applied by lucas at 3951234575. Details: tenant=solstice pinned to stable-v2. Monitoring window started.
eng-runtime-ali: add explicit safevariant param to avoid quantized fast path while we investigate: apply model=stable-v2:safe-serial on tenant routing. Also recommend a short canary before full traffic restoration.
support-jasmin: shared to Solstice CS: we've pinned their tenant and derated traffic, critical flows should be stable. We'll follow up in 15m with status.
oncall-erin: handing to @eng-runtime-ali for post-mitigation monitoring and RCA kickoff. Please update this thread with go/no-go to remove pin.
eng-runtime-ali: taking ownership. I'll run stress test on v3-quant in staging with longer sequences and updated driver. Opening RCA ticket: "RCA-3951: quant kernel + driver interaction causes KV thrash under prod seqs".
cust-ops-solstice: thanks — critical payments path looks OK now. We'll keep non-critical traffic reduced. Please advise before removing pin.
oncall-erin: current plan: monitor 30m, if errors hold at baseline then remove derate and gradually unpin via canary. If regression, engage SRE for node-level remediation. Last check in this thread at 3951234899.
